description: Returns UK Global Tariff data for a 6–10-digit commodity code via the UK Trade Tariff API (OGL v3): description, third-country duty rate, VAT, measures, and preferential rates for a given origin country. Text search (`q`) returns matching commodity headings. Coverage: UK only, post-Brexit schedule. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

code.description: 6–10-digit commodity code (e.g. 8471300000). Omit to use q.

origin.description: Optional ISO-2 country code for preferential duty lookup (e.g. US, CN)

q.description: Keyword search for commodity headings (max 200 characters)

name: tariff_uk
title: Tariff Uk
